operationalFindings: The default binding store is ~/.relay/codex-dsh-links.json and does not follow DSH_HOME; isolated runs must set RELAY_CODEX_LINK_PATH.
The bundled launcher enables Codex analytics by default.
The plugin assumes an existing Codex login and does not expose account login/logout controls through its DSH product surface.
The observed App Server catalog default was deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, so Pro-backed validation must select an explicit Codex model.
gpt-5.6-luna emitted raw DSML tool markup as assistant text instead of a structured tool call.
A fresh gpt-5.6-sol Session claimed command execution results without emitting DSH tool/call or tool/result events.
Switching an existing Thread from gpt-5.6-luna to gpt-5.6-sol failed with invalid_encrypted_content.
decision: do-not-install-in-aezy-profile; implement a minimal out-of-tree official-app-server adapter behind the same DSH Session/provider/tool/approval seams
